lookup.context_partition: direct page below $1000 selects base $3F90 and bias $0000; otherwise base $3FA4 and bias $00C8
lookup.first_index: base + direct-page $68; low 5 bits of the resulting WRAM word are doubled for DATA_81:95EB
lookup.second_index: context bias + DATA_81:95EB word + saved A
lookup.return: word read from WRAM $7E:0000 at second index

limitations: The direct-page partition, $68, DATA_81:95EB values, and returned word have no human-readable player/control semantics assigned here.
This proves a lookup mechanism, not that every caller uses the returned word as an animation selector.
WRAM content is runtime data and is not distributed by this artifact.
